Yes, please — that's exactly the kind of thing I'd want it to be smart about. To me, `www` or no `www`, a slash on the end or not, and especially those long tracking bits that get tacked on when I copy a link from somewhere — those are all just the same page as far as I'm concerned. I don't even notice those differences most of the time.

So if I go to save one of those and I've already got that page, I'd want it to recognize it as the one I already have and take me to edit that existing bookmark, rather than treating it as brand new and giving me a near-identical duplicate. The whole reason I liked the duplicate-catching earlier was to keep my library from filling up with the same thing twice — and these sneaky little address differences are probably the most common way that'd happen. So yes, it should see through them.
